summary: Descendants and the spouse are guaranteed half of their intestate share, with a smaller share for other close relatives. Montenegro has no trust law and is outside the Hague Trusts Convention. Foundations are limited to non-profit use.
reserved_share: Descendants, adoptees and spouse: 1/2 of the intestate share; parents and other heirs 1/3; Law on Succession (OG 74/2008). Article numbers not confirmed.
foreign_law_note: The 2013 Law on Private International Law governs succession; whether a foreign national may choose their national law was not confirmed.
trust_note: No trust law. Foundations are non-profit bodies under the Law on Non-Governmental Organisations.
open_questions: Statute article numbers and exact fractions for forced heirs outside descendants and spouse were not read in the primary text; confirm in the official gazette.
Whether a foreign national resident may choose a law for their estate under the current private international law act was not confirmed.
